title: Music on the road, and a fairer fight
text:
The music now travels with you, and every class has had its damage brought in line.

⬆️ The music no longer cuts off when you leave town. It keeps playing as you travel, gives way to battle music in a fight, and picks up again where it paused once the fight is over. Dungeons keep their own eerie music
• Bulwark, Mender, Arcanist, Assassin and Bard: auto attacks and every ability deal about 12% less damage, the same cut the Barbarian and Hunter received in v0.63. Healing is unchanged
